name: Reuben The Tribe Of
overview: The tribe of Reuben, descended from Jacob's first son, is portrayed in Scripture as a significant yet complex part of Israel's history. Numbered among the tribes able to go to war, Reuben was counted at over forty-six thousand men, highlighting its strength at the time of receiving their inheritance east of the Jordan. Positioned south of the tabernacle during the wilderness encampment, Reuben's role in Israel's journey and organization is emphasized, with leaders such as Elizur son of Shedeur appointed over them. However, the tribe also carries a cautionary note of instability, as reflected in Jacob's rebuke concerning Reuben's actions within his family.
